content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad dominate the digital commerce landscape, but their restrictions and high fees can be a major hurdle for many creators. Gumroad, for instance, charges a whopping 10% commission on every sale, while Stripe and PayPal also impose various fees. But what if you could bypass these platforms altogether and own your digital commerce infrastructure? With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can deploy a complete combination of free and paid tools that give you a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This means you can sell digital products without relying on any platform, and retain 99.5% of your revenue.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, you'll need a few essential tools. First, you'll need a domain name and a web hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, you'll need a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment processing and product delivery. You'll also need an order storage tool like Supabase or Google Sheets to store customer information and order details. Finally, you'll need a file delivery tool like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver your digital products to customers. Once you have these tools, you can start building your sovereign digital commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With your tools in place, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This is where NOWPayments comes in – a cryptocurrency payment gateway that allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Litecoin. With NOWPayments, you can automatically verify on-chain payments and deliver your digital products to customers. You'll also need to configure your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment processing and product delivery. This will involve setting up API keys, webhooks, and other essential integrations to ensure seamless payment processing and product delivery.
You can start selling digital products with crypto today, without any platform restrictions, and retain 99.5% of your revenue.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your payment and delivery pipeline set up, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This is an exciting moment, as you'll finally be able to sell digital products to customers without relying on any platform. To process your first transaction, simply create a new product and configure your payment settings in NOWPayments. Then, test your payment processing and product delivery pipeline to ensure everything is working smoothly. Once you're confident that everything is in place, you can start promoting your products and selling digital goods to customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your sovereign digital commerce stack is up and running, you can start scaling your business to new heights. With the Sovereign Blueprint, you'll get complete documentation for all 5 stacks, full source code, NOWPayments integration guide, and scaling playbook. This will help you optimize your payment processing and product delivery pipeline, reduce fees, and increase your revenue. You can also use the Sovereign Blueprint to deploy additional stacks and scale your business to meet growing demand.
Do I need an LLC to sell digital products?

Do I need an LLC to sell digital products? No, you don't need an LLC to sell digital products. However, owning your digital commerce infrastructure and using a sovereign digital commerce stack can provide you with more control and flexibility over your business, regardless of its legal structure. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can sell digital products without relying on any platform, and retain 99.5% of your revenue. This means you can keep more of your hard-earned money and focus on growing your business. By owning your infrastructure, you can also reduce your reliance on platforms and avoid their fees, which can add up quickly. In fact, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between Gumroad's 10% commission and NOWPayments' 0.5% fee retains $921. That's a significant difference that can make a big impact on your bottom line. By owning your infrastructure, you can keep more of your revenue and grow your business faster.

With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can deploy a complete combination of free and paid tools that give you a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.

Configure an order storage tool like Supabase or Google Sheets to store customer information and order details.
